entities.summary: Richard Norton was an Australian martial artist, actor, stunt performer, stunt coordinator, security consultant and fight choreographer. He held a 5th dan Black Belt in Gōjū-ryū karate, a 6th Dan Black Belt in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, an 8th Dan Black Belt in Chun Kuk Do, and a Level 6 ranking in American Kickboxing. After high school, Norton worked as a bodyguard in the entertainment business before pursuing an acting career.
